source.title: Appointment of a WCA Advisory Council Leader (January 2019)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of our first WCA Council Leader. The successful passing of the proposed amendments to the Motions established the **WCA Advisory Council** through [WCA Motion 20.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf). The WAC is an Advisory Council of the WCA which is responsible for building and maintaining bilateral communication between the WCA Community and the WCA Staff.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Council. The qualities expected of candidates are:

- Strong leadership skills
- Excellent communication skills
- Good knowledge of the WCA structure
- A strong connection to the WCA Community

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents **until January 31st, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board** ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA Community.
3. Ambitions as the WAC Leader.

**All received applications will be made public at the end of the application period.**

The rights and duties of the WAC are copied from the WAC’s Motion in the appendix below.

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 4.1 of [WCA Motion 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

APPENDIX - RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF THE WCA ADVISORY COUNCIL

1. The WCA Advisory Council has the following rights and duties:
    1. Establishing communication channels between the WCA Community and the WCA Board, providing direct feedback from Registered Speedcubers about the WCA operations.
        1. The WCA Advisory Council shall ensure that the demands and requests of the WCA Community are heard and addressed by WCA Staff.
    2. Recruiting Community Members who are able and willing to help improve the WCA operations.
    3. Improving and further promoting transparency in the WCA.
    4. Improving bilateral communication between the WCA Community and WCA Staff.

translation.title: WCA 顾问理事会首任负责人招募（2019 年 1 月）
translation.content:
我们将任命 WCA 首位理事会负责人。相关动议修订已获通过，[WCA 动议 20.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf)据此设立了 **WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）**。WAC 负责建立和维护 WCA 社区与工作人员之间的双向沟通。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 8 小时参与理事会工作。我们希望申请者具备：

* 较强的领导能力。
* 出色的沟通能力。
* 熟悉 WCA 的组织架构。
* 与 WCA 社区保持紧密联系。

即日起接受申请，请于 **2019 年 1 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下向 WCA 董事会**提交材料（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

1. 简短的自我介绍。
2. 为 WCA 社区所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WAC 负责人的工作设想。

**收到的所有申请材料都将在申请截止后公开。**

WAC 的权利与职责摘自 WAC 动议，附于下文。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将依据 [WCA 动议 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf) 第 4.1 节投票选出新负责人，并公布结果。

感谢大家的申请和支持。

### 附录：WCA 顾问理事会的权利与职责

1. WCA 顾问理事会拥有以下权利与职责：
   1. 建立 WCA 社区与 WCA 董事会之间的沟通渠道，提供已注册速拧选手对 WCA 运作的直接反馈。
      1. 确保 WCA 社区的需求和请求得到 WCA 工作人员的倾听与处理。
   2. 招募有能力且愿意帮助改进 WCA 运作的社区成员。
   3. 改善并进一步推动 WCA 的透明度。
   4. 改善 WCA 社区与工作人员之间的双向沟通。
